                }

                }

              ping yes;
            }

            }

              }

                }
              }
            }
          }
          rulebase {
            security {
              rules {

                  from trust;
                  to untrust;
                  source any;
                  destination any;

                  category any;

                  category any;
                  application any;
                  service any;
